leverage.exposure: Cash is effectively nothing, the two live offers commit far more than the balance holds, and a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday. The forced sale helps the balance — it brings in the largest single sum available — but only if it can be executed, and it cannot be executed until a purchase has landed. Hold onto that inversion: buy first, then sell the forced sale together with one more, and get above zero well before the lock rather than near it, because the values of every remaining sale candidate drift down while the deadline stays fixed.

binding_gap: Sale allowance, but no longer an emergency. Allowance equals buys made, so with nothing landed the forced sale cannot be executed — and with only the expensive offer landing, the forced sale absorbs the single permitted slot and still leaves the balance short. Both failure modes vanish for well under a million by adding one cheap outfield body, and with the deadline confirmed as the matchday lock there is ample time to do that after the auction resolves rather than before. The decision point is tomorrow midday.

verdict.detail: Suzuki is a forced sale under the league's MVP rule, and Georg has confirmed the rule's deadline is the next matchday lock — which means there is real slack and nothing to do tonight. The one structural catch remains: selling him consumes a unit of sale allowance, allowance equals the number of buys made, and no buy has landed yet. So the sale that repairs the balance is itself gated on a purchase. Since both live offers may yet supply that purchase for free, the right move now is to wait for the Maluze auction to resolve tomorrow midday and then pick the branch. Everything after that is cheap to fix.

sell.reason: Suzuki goes because the rule says so, paired with Sylla — that combination clears the balance comfortably and lands a legal shape, and Sylla carries his own reason to go, with dated reports of his club cutting the asking price and no buyer as the real-world window closes. Pairing the forced sale with Widmer does not clear zero and is the one pairing to avoid. Bernardo is the alternative partner and also clears, though he raises less and his value falls fastest. Sambi Lokonga now stays: with the forced sale gone, the midfield cannot afford to lose him too, which reverses the earlier call on him. Prefer listing the forced sale to the league rather than dumping it back to the market — manager asks here clear a few percent above market value, worth several hundred thousand more, though a buyer is not guaranteed and the deadline works against the seller.

standing.name: Suzuki
standing.why: MANDATORY, NOT A VALUE JUDGEMENT. **LEAGUE HOUSE RULE: this league plays the MVP rule** - Georg told us 31.08.2026 that the matchday MVP must be sold, and Suzuki topped MD1 with ap 395 (hat-trick 29/48/55 v Werder, scfreiburg.com 30.08.2026). Every future run must treat this rule as standing: whoever tops a matchday has to go, however good he is. Suzuki is the best player in the squad and on pure points we would never sell him - the rule overrides. TWO CONSEQUENCES that change everything: (1) the sale consumes one unit of sale allowance, and allowance equals buys made, so with 0 buys landed he CANNOT sell Suzuki at all - the obligation is BLOCKED until Maluze or Eggestein lands. (2) If only Eggestein lands, the single permitted sale must be Suzuki and that still leaves -1.507.287 = NEGATIVE at the lock = ZERO points for all of MD2. Only the both-offers-land branch is safe: Suzuki + Sylla -> +6.389.301 and squad 1GK/5DEF/3MID/2ATT = 5-3-2, or Suzuki + Bernardo -> +3.840.565 and 4-3-3. Do NOT pair with Widmer (-603.478). Prefer LISTING him to the league over dumping to Kickbase: manager asks here clear at +3,06% to +4,35%, worth roughly 450k-640k more than mv, though a buyer is not guaranteed. Do NOT reinvest the proceeds on this board - Eggestein ap 124 is the best MID available and is already bid; the next best is Koemuer ap 44 (benched) and Aouchiche ap 40. There is no replacement for ap 395 here. Hold the cash for a better board.

standing.name: Bernardo
standing.why: Replaces S2kausk (closed) with corrected reasoning - the previous call overstated the evidence. PARTIAL WALK-BACK: the "hooked at 53 for his direct competitor Hranac" premise is NOT corroborated. Robin Hranac's Ligainsider profile carries no dated news at all since before August 2026, so the substitution cannot be read as a positional demotion; Ligainsider's Hoffenheim page instead has Prass injured and lists Gendrey as the other left-side option, and Bernardo was declared available again on 28.08.2026 after being held out 22.08 as "leicht angeschlagen", then started MD1. No MD2 left-back call exists anywhere dated - no club has published an XI. So the real and only solid case for selling is financial, not selection: mv 6.547.852 with sdmvt -1.013.483, i.e. falling ~1M/day, and he is the 4th-worst scorer at ap 61. DEMOTED to third funding leg behind Lokonga and Sylla and explicitly NOT needed if those two land - the Lokonga+Sylla pair alone clears the hole at +2,33M. Sell him only if a third buy forces a third sale, and if so sell EARLY: every day of delay costs ~1M of proceeds.

standing.name: Widmer
standing.why: Confirmed benched: did not start MD1, on 73' for Caci in Mainz 0:0 Paderborn 29.08.2026; both 2026/27 appearances as substitute, da Costa in the back three. ap 29, mv falling. Only 2,10M so low priority - keep him as the 12th body if only one buy lands.

buy.reason: Hold both live offers exactly as placed and raise neither. Eggestein has been promoted by circumstance from luxury to replacement — he is the best midfielder available anywhere on the board by a wide margin, verified starting after a full ninety in a comfortable win, with the offer sitting at market value against an ask unsold for a week. Maluze remains the best points return per euro on the board, verified with a full debut start, an assist and a contract extension the same week. No third purchase tonight: the cheap-body idea is now a conditional rather than an action, because it insures a risk that resolves tomorrow midday with days of slack still in hand. If it is ever needed, any sub-million outfield listing serves — the body count matters, not the identity, and the board refreshes such listings constantly, so there is no need to chase one before it expires. It must be outfield: a second keeper leaves too few outfield players to fill any legal formation. Do not reinvest the forced-sale proceeds on this board — after Eggestein the next best midfielders are a confirmed substitute and a low scorer on a falling value, so the money should wait for a better board. The reversal on Vagnoman stands.

standing.name: Maluze
standing.why: Replaces closed BUY-mal to record the bid Georg ACTUALLY placed: 1.200.000, not the 1.000.000 in the old call. That is +29,48% over mv 926.799, above the highest premium ever measured in this league (+20,96% Campbell), which is the right way to bid a blind Kickbase auction on a cheap player - the absolute cost of overpaying is ~270k. VERIFIED 31.08: fit, debut start 95 of 96 min with 1 assist and a 1,5 rating alongside Robin Koch in the 3:3 at Union Berlin 29.08.2026, replaced Otavio in the XI (hessenschau ticker 29.08.26 14:57), named a match winner 30.08.26, contract extended to 2031 on 29.08.26. Best points-per-euro on the board by a wide margin: ap 184 at 0,93M mv. Displaces Widmer ap 29 from the fielded XI. Note MD2 XI unverifiable - no club has published one as of 31.08 - and no dated item confirming Collins out could be found, though Kickbase carries Collins st=4 "after back problems - in rehabilitation training". HOLD the bid, do not raise.

killed_this_run.name: Ljubicic
killed_this_run.why: Resolves WATCH Wf35klh (closed). NOW VERIFIED and the verification is clean: fit, no injury/suspension flag, STARTED MD1 at Augsburg 94 of 95 min (schalketotal.de lineup report 30.08.2026), tactical shift to the right when Adamu came on, not a hook. So the starter question is answered yes. Avoided anyway on value and capacity: ap 32 for 5,91M is poor next to Vagnoman ap 73 at 6,92M and Maluze ap 184 at 0,93M, the MD2 fixture is Schalke at home to Bayern, and Georg already fields 3 MID with Eggestein ap 124 pending. Above all it would consume unwind capacity he does not have: see the Vagnoman reversal - only the Lokonga+Sylla pair clears zero as it is.

killed_this_run.name: Vagnoman
killed_this_run.why: REVERSAL of BUY Boleuh6 and RAISE Rf17mrr, both now closed unexecuted (no bid was ever placed - ofc=0 on the listing). Verified fit: full 90 at Bayern MD1, Hoeness backed him 29.08.2026 - but that same Ligainsider piece says he is NOT a guaranteed starter, only "needed urgently" with Assignon and Nartey injured. The reversal is not about him, it is about the unwind. Cash is 100.941 and live offers on Maluze (1,20M) + Eggestein (16,31M) already put the balance at -17.404.868 if both land. N buys permit exactly N sales, and with 2 buys the ONLY sale pair that clears zero is Lokonga+Sylla (19,73M -> +2,33M); every other pair leaves him negative at the lock = ZERO points for all of MD2. Adding Vagnoman at 8,30M (+19,88% over mv) forces a 3rd sale that must be Bernardo, whose mv is falling ~1M/day, on a margin of ~480k over four days. And the job Vagnoman was bought for is already done cheaper: Maluze ap 184 at 1,20M displaces Widmer ap 29. Vagnoman would only displace Bernardo ap 61 for +12 ap at 8,30M. Bad points-per-euro and it endangers the whole matchday.

movers.reason: Still no mechanism: no manager is asking below market value, so there is no spread to capture, and the flips in the feed were rivals cycling cheap players for a fraction of a percent. With a forced sale to execute and a balance to bring back above zero, capacity spent on a flip is capacity that threatens the matchday. No action.

fitness.sweep: No squad player is newly injured, suspended or flagged, and the forced sale is not a fitness matter — Suzuki is fully fit and scored a hat-trick, which is exactly why the rule caught him. Matsima and Gregoritsch both started and both appear in their club's published probable eleven. Guirassy started and scored; Baumann and Minjae started, and the exit talk around Minjae is reported closed. Widmer's demotion hardened this run — he is missing from his club's probable eleven published today. Two gaps stated plainly: nothing dated since late August exists for Nusa, so his fitness is unconfirmed though he is off the injured and suspended table; and no club in the league has published a matchday-two eleven yet, so every starter claim here is inference from minutes played and dated coach comment, not a confirmed lineup.
